in_marathi.name: Druthiya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Druthiya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Druthiya is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Drutha' which means 'Seeker' or 'Truthful'. This name is believed to have originated in Hindu mythology and is often given to children who are believed to possess the qualities of truthfulness and a strong desire for knowledge and understanding.
